For the Informant : Mr. Dharmendra Kumar Singh, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 09-08-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, State and the informant.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Garkha P.S. Case No. 197 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 498A, 341, 323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, lodged on 08.04.2022 by the informant, Khushi Singh.

3. Since the informant has already appeared, with the consent of the parties, let the matter go before the Mediation Center where the couple will appear on 22.08.2024 and a report Patna High Court CR.

4. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Garkha P.S. Case No. 197 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Abhimanyu Kumar Singh @ Abhimanyu Kumar ... vs The State Of Bihar on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7097908/
